errors.evidence: The y-axis values are numerical, but no units are provided in the chart. Stating the measurement is in 'thousands of people' is an unverified assumption.

errors.text_span: етикетите са разположени равномерно с интервал от едно тримесечие
errors.evidence: The labels on the x-axis are not spaced at one-quarter intervals. For example, the labels shown are 2003Q1, 2004Q2, 2005Q3, etc., which are spaced by more than one quarter.

errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена като „Общо Безработица“
errors.evidence: The chart title is "Общо Безработица" (Total Unemployment), not the y-axis label. The y-axis has no label.
The line starts at exactly 500.0 in 2003Q1, not approximately 550.0.

errors.text_span: достигащ връх от около 450,0 хиляди души през 2011Q2
errors.evidence: The peak value of approximately 450 is reached around 2013Q1, not 2011Q2. In 2011Q2, the value is approximately 400.

errors.text_span: стойността достига около 200,0 хиляди души през 2014Q2
errors.evidence: In 2014Q2, the value is approximately 350, not 200. A value of 200 is reached around 2017.
The chart shows a sharp increase in 2020Q3, not a sharp drop.
Following the sharp increase in 2020Q3, the value is over 200, not approximately 120.0.
